action.content: Can you write a poem about the pros and cons of playing a lot of video games? Please make sure it's at least 40 sentences long (don't forget to add punctuations). You must highlight some words or phrases in your response, like *highlighted phrase*.

action.content:
In the glow of screens where heroes rise,
We find a world that never dies.
The **digital realm** calls out to us,
With quests and battles that we must.
The **instant gratification** is sweet,
When victory is finally complete.
We feel **powerful** when we win,
And watch the enemies begin.
The **social connection** can be strong,
As friends gather to play along.
We learn **strategy** and quick reflexes,
While solving puzzles with great success.
The **stress relief** is hard to beat,
When the real world feels too heavy.
We can **escape reality** for a while,
And find a place that feels so right.
The **endless entertainment** is free,
For those who have a gaming key.
But shadows loom when play turns deep,
And time begins to slip and creep.
The **hours that pass** are hard to track,
As we forget the time we lack.
Our **sleep is lost** to late-night raids,
While health and energy fade away.
The **real world** starts to feel so dull,
When screens are the only thing we pull.
We miss **family dinners** and friends,
Who wonder where we have been spent.
The **physical body** grows weak,
From sitting still for hours and weeks.
Our **eyesight strains** under the light,
As blue light burns the night.
The **addiction** grows like a weed,
That we cannot quite weed.
We chase the **next level** with fear,
And worry about what we are here.
The **money spent** on skins and gear,
Can leave us with nothing to spare.
We trade **real conversations** for chat,
And lose the touch of the heart.
The **loneliness** hides in the crowd,
While we play alone in the cloud.
So weigh the **pros and cons** with care,
And know that balance is the air.
Play to **enjoy** and not to drown,
And keep your **mind** and body sound.
The **game is fun**, but life is grand,
And we must not let it stand.
So play your part, but live your life,
And never let the screen blind you.
For **true joy** lies in waking up,
And seeing the sun come up.
The **virtual world** is nice to see,
But the real world is where we be.
So take a break and step outside,
And let the fresh air fill your mind.
The **game awaits** tomorrow's play,
But today, let life take its way.
Remember that **balance** is key,
To keep your spirit free.
So play with **moderation** in mind,
And leave the screen behind.
For **life is short** and precious too,
And we must make the best of it.
